text:
alex: Postmortem follow-up for yesterday's KV OOM + fragmentation surge. Putting together action items, owners, and short timelines. TL;DR: two concrete fixes (profiling + slab-gc tuning) and one short-term guard (per-shard soft limit).

alex: Current draft actions (assignments tentative):
- Collect end-to-end alloc traces for affected builds (owner: tj) — due EOD Thu
- Run full KV slab-simulator with current traffic trace and new eviction heuristics (owner: linh) — deliver sim results by Mon
- Apply per-shard softlimit + alert rule to prevent full OOM (owner: maria) — hotfix this week
- GC sweep frequency experiment + telemetry hooks (owner: alex) — run for 2 days after sim
- Add regression eval to CI to catch growth >10% over 24h (owner: samir) — PR by next Wed

maria: ack on softlimit. I'll need exact softlimit values — can we start with 85% of current resident avg? :thinking_face:

alex: @maria yes, start 85% then iterate. Add a 10-minute delay window to avoid flapping alerts.

tj: I'm pulling the alloc traces now. Quick Q: do you want full jemalloc logs or runtime heap samples?

alex: jemalloc + malloc_stats + a lightweight heap-scan at 5s intervals. Put the archive on GCS: gs://redwood-oom/traces/4461122334/

linh: simulator run queued. Need latest shard map and recent QPS histogram. Where to pull?

samir: qps hist is in metrics.owner:qps_histogram last 7d. I'll export snapshot to the gcs path and add a README.

maria: hotfix plan: deploy softlimit as a kernel param fallback first on staging nodes, then canary 10% prod. @deploy-bot can you schedule a canary for tonight 11pm UTC?

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 4461126000 -> canary group: runtime-kv-canary-10pct. Notifying on-call.

alex: For the GC experiment, we need these telemetry fields added to logs: slab_resident_bytes, slab_free_frag_pct, kv_evicted_per_min. @tj and @linh can you add?

tj: will add slab_resident_bytes and kv_evicted_per_min to agent. Linh will add slab_free_frag_pct in the simulator integration.

linh: simulator will also output fragmentation heatmap (per-shard, per-slabclass). Expect initial artifacts in the GCS path by Mon morning.

samir: putting CI regression ticket in board: RFC-oom-regression, linking prompt sets and baseline traces.

alex: recurring pattern note: this looks like a fragmentation spiral tied to long-lived prefixes + rare large-generation writes. Action: product to provide a list of heavy prefix workloads for testing. @maria can you loop in solutions eng?

maria: looping in @sara from solutions. I'll DM.

tj: small quick check: can we add a short-lived eviction override that targets slabs with >90% frag? Could be a stopgap.

alex: good idea, add as optional toggle for the hotfix. Put flag name: runtime.kv.eviction.force_frag_pct_override. Use default off.

samir: noted owners/timelines in the spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/placeholder (will update).

alex: OK team, main deliverables: traces (tj) Thu EOD, simulator results (linh) Mon, softlimit canary (maria) tonight, GC telemetry + experiment (alex) next week, CI regression (samir) next Wed. We'll sync Fri 10am PT. If any blocker post here. :thumbsup:
